intentAttribution.rule: Never infer intent from wording, emotion, political position, or a single content item.

riskLevels.low: Mostly ordinary rhetoric or persuasion; no material deception or high-cost action is evident.
riskLevels.medium: One or more relevant signals or evidence gaps; proposed actions remain reversible.
riskLevels.high: Multiple signals combine, or the content pushes a costly or hard-to-reverse action.
riskLevels.urgent: Credentials, remote access, irreversible payment, immediate safety, or acute medical action is involved.

prohibitedOutputs: Personality or psychiatric diagnosis from content
Intent attribution without behavioral, network, or internal evidence
Claims of fact-checking when no external evidence was used
Fabricated sources, forensic findings, account networks, or search results
Medical, legal, investment, safety, or major career decisions made for the user
